: Discover a unique selection of vintage estate smoking pipes, perfect for collectors, restoration enthusiasts, or creative upcycling projects. This mixed lot includes 14 assorted pipes, each featuring a range of shapes, materials, and finishes. Styles present include both straight and curved stems, with bowl materials appearing to be primarily wood and one with a lighter, possibly meerschaum, finish. Several stems and bowls show notable signs of wear, chipping, or separation, making these ideal candidates for repair or repurposing.
Whether you're rebuilding classic pieces, sourcing parts, or simply appreciate the craftsmanship of traditional pipes, this assorted lot offers intriguing visual appeal and variety. The lot's visible condition ranges broadly, with some pipes intact and others suited for parts or display only. Please note: all pipes are pre-owned and sold as is, with visible chips, cracks, and missing pieces on several items as shown in the images. No additional accessories are included. 278503346.description: This vintage mid-century pipe smoker's set includes a cork and brass base, a brass lidded tobacco jar showing visible patina and oxidation inside, a wooden and plastic smoking pipe, and two brass pipe rests. The brass components display tarnish and wear consistent with age, and the pipe shows signs of use. The cork base has pads on the underside for stability. The set features classic mid-century modern design elements and visible flaws include patina inside the jar and tarnish on the brass parts.

277826824.description:
Product Overview:
This listing includes a set of polished mineral specimens featuring Ruby in Zoisite, Ruby Fuchsite, and Ruby in Matrix. Each specimen has distinct coloration and patterning with polished surfaces.

Specifications:
- Ruby in Zoisite: Dark green and black matrix with pink-red ruby inclusions.
- Ruby Fuchsite: Bright pink to magenta hues with white and dark mineral inclusions, cut in a triangular shape.
- Ruby in Matrix: Rougher texture with ruby crystals embedded in white and gray host rock.
- All specimens are tumbled and polished.
- Approximate largest specimen size: 1.5 inches.

This specimen is in good, gently used condition, suitable for mineral collections or decorative display.
